purpose: The shared error handler every integration calls: classifies a non-2xx response, decides whether to retry, suppress, or page on-call, and composes the alert.

reads.note: pasted verbatim into the alert; the deprecation hint in this one is what told the team to stop asking for total_count
an `invalid_request_error` is a bug in our code and is never retried
a 404 is retried once and then dropped; any other failing status pages on-call
`resource_missing` is suppressed from the alert channel entirely
the offending parameter recorded on the alert so the owning team can find it
